description: Research-oriented English-taught programme with strong hands-on laboratory training and flexible study pathways across plant biochemistry, physiology and molecular biology; plant cell biology and development; and plant biodiversity, evolution and systematics.
Agricultural Science degree. Final grade: 3.58. Thesis: Yield, Profitability And Prospect of Growth Parameters of different Mustard Varieties in the Barind Tract Area of Chapai Nawabganj.
